tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Screen background. Warm off-white in light, warm near-black in dark. Cards on it show by tone alone (1.13:1 light, 1.12:1 dark).

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets, set on background. No border, no shadow: the change of tone is the separation.

tokens.name: textPrimary
tokens.usage: Main text on background and surface.

tokens.name: textSecondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text and labels on background and surface (5.2:1 light, 6.8:1 dark on background).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Warm coral. The record button and recording circle, the streak, and the one main button on a screen. Never more than one accent button per screen.

tokens.name: onAccent
tokens.usage: Label on an accent fill (5.2:1 light, 6.7:1 dark). Never white: white on coral is only 3.3:1 / 2.8:1. A deeper coral with white labels was turned down: it only passes in light mode.

tokens.name: accentText
tokens.usage: Accent-coloured text and links on background and surface (4.7:1 on background in light).

tokens.name: accentSoft
tokens.usage: The glow behind the recording circle and soft highlights. Accent at 15% (light) / 12% (dark: at 20% it read as a muddy ring). Never carries text meaning on its own.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Improvement only (fewer fillers, less off-track time), always with an arrow and words. 5.0:1 on background in light.

tokens.name: divider
tokens.usage: Rare separators only. Prefer empty space. Decorative: not for borders that carry meaning.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Control fills: the segmented track, quiet fills, pickers. Warm, so standard controls never sit cool grey on the warm background.

styles.name: question
styles.usage: The daily question, on Home and at the top of the recording screen. textPrimary.
styles.sample: What's one thing you'd change about how your team runs meetings?

styles.name: betterVersion
styles.usage: The rewritten better version of your answer, and the coach's note: long reading text, so about 1.4× leading. textPrimary.
styles.sample: I'd cut our weekly status meeting to fifteen minutes, because most updates could be a written note.

styles.name: largeTitle
styles.usage: The name of each top-level screen (Progress, Settings, the before-and-after), in the same place every time. textPrimary.

styles.name: bigNumber
styles.usage: Digits only: the streak and single big numbers (Stat). Tabular figures. A word uses headline. textPrimary.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: A heading inside a screen, and the feedback headline. textPrimary.
styles.sample: You found your point while talking.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: A long, important line: the tip. textPrimary.
styles.sample: Next time, tell the listener where you're going in your first sentence.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: All running text, buttons and the listener's restatement. textPrimary.
styles.sample: Your point came at 1:10, after two passes around it. Next time, say where you're going in your first sentence.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels above values and small supporting lines. textSecondary by default.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Times and small notes. textSecondary by default.

type.note: Standard styles use the font's natural leading, about 1.2× (a 17 pt line measures 20.34 pt in Button.tsx); Dynamic Type scales size and leading together. Only long serif reading text (betterVersion) sets a line height, about 1.4×. Numbers that change or sit in a column use tabular figures. Text on screen uses typographic quotes (’ “ ”).

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Label to value inside a Stat; arrow to its words.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Gap between lines inside a Card.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Gap between the recording circle at its biggest and its time ring.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding.

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Screen top and bottom padding; space between sections.

tokens.name: space-xxl
tokens.usage: Space between major groups on a screen.

tokens.name: space-xxxl
tokens.usage: The largest step. Generous empty space around the one main action.

tokens.name: screen-margin
tokens.usage: Left and right margin on every screen.

tokens.name: radius-button
tokens.usage: Buttons (rounded rectangle).

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: The record button and the recording circle: a full circle.

size.note: Fixed sizes for the custom moments: the recording circle, tap targets and the answer line.

tokens.name: record-button
tokens.usage: Minimum diameter of the record button, easy to hit with a thumb.

tokens.name: record-circle-core
tokens.usage: Diameter of the coral recording circle at rest. Grows to 1.2× with a loud voice.

tokens.name: record-ring-stroke
tokens.usage: Width of the thin time ring around the recording circle.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum height of every tap target. Quiet buttons are capsules: fully rounded at this height.

tokens.name: answer-line
tokens.usage: Height of the answer line on the feedback screen.

tokens.name: answer-line-compare
tokens.usage: Height of each answer line on the before-and-after.

tokens.name: answer-line-gap
tokens.usage: Space between the answer line's segments.

tokens.name: answer-line-outline
tokens.usage: Line width of outlined segments (Direction, Support, Ending).
